title: Grass-fed or Organic: Which Is Healthier?
summary: Dr. Berg compares grass-fed and organic beef labels and recommends grass-fed, grass-finished, certified organic meat.

assertions.quote: grain-fed beef has about a 20 to 1 ratio very very heavy on the omega-6 fatty acids versus the grass-fed beef is like a two-to-one
if it doesn't say grass-finished it's going to be grain finished
if something says it's just organic it's 95 to 99 percent organic

verdicts.note: Products labeled 'organic' must contain at least 95 percent organic ingredients by weight, excluding water and salt (205.301(b)), and only '100 percent organic' and 'organic' products may carry the USDA seal (205.303(a)(4)).
A product carrying the USDA organic seal must be certified and have 95 percent or more organic content.

assertions.quote: what does organic mean it means without pesticides herbicides fungicides and insecticides
if something is organic it's not gonna have antibiotics or hormones or bio solids
yes they feed animals sewage sludge

verdicts.note: Biosolids are spread on some cropland and pasture under EPA rules, but they are not fed to livestock as feed.
